info.title: Subscription Tracker API
info.description: API for tracking personal subscription services with multi-currency support, automated payment tracking, and spending analytics.

tags.name: Payments
tags.description: Payment records and FX rate management

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: User registration, login, token refresh, and session management

get.description: Retrieves the current user's preferences including default currency.

put.description: Updates the current user's preferences including default currency.

get.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific subscription including payment history.

put.description: Updates an existing subscription's details including amount, billing cycle, and notes.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a subscription and all associated payment records.

get.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific service.

put.description: Updates an existing custom service. Only user-created services can be modified.

400.description: Invalid request data or cannot modify global service

delete.description: Deletes a custom service. Only user-created services can be deleted.

400.description: Cannot delete global service or service in use

put.description: Updates an existing payment record's details.

post.description: Changes the current user's password. Requires the current password for verification.

400.description: Invalid password or password requirements not met

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of subscriptions for the authenticated user. Supports filtering by status, category, and search term.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status (ACTIVE, CANCELLED, PAUSED, or 'all')

post.description: Creates a new subscription for the authenticated user with the specified service, amount, currency, and billing cycle.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of services available to the user, including global services and user-created custom services.

post.description: Creates a new custom service for the user.
Creates a new manual payment record for a subscription.
Manually triggers a refresh of foreign exchange rates from the external API. Requires ADMIN role.

500.description: Failed to fetch FX rates from external API

post.description: Verifies the TOTP code from authenticator app. Requires partial token from initial login. Returns full authentication tokens on success.
Generates a TOTP secret and QR code for authenticator app setup. The user must verify the setup by providing a valid code from the app.
Verifies the TOTP code and enables 2FA. Returns recovery codes that should be saved securely - they cannot be viewed again.

400.description: Invalid code or setup not initiated

post.description: Uses a backup recovery code when authenticator app is unavailable. Each code can only be used once.
Generates new recovery codes, replacing all existing ones. Requires TOTP code verification.
Disables two-factor authentication. Requires password and TOTP code verification.
Creates a new user account with the provided email and password. Returns both an access token and a refresh token for authentication.
Uses a valid refresh token to obtain a new access token. The refresh token is rotated for security - a new refresh token is returned.
Revokes the provided refresh token so it cannot be used to obtain new access tokens. The client should also discard the access token.
Authenticates a user with email and password credentials. Returns both an access token and a refresh token for authentication.
Resends the verification email to the currently authenticated user. Rate limited to 1 request per 2 minutes.

patch.description: Reactivates a previously cancelled subscription with a new billing date.
Cancels an active subscription. The subscription can optionally be reactivated later.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of payment records for a specific subscription.
Retrieves the change history timeline for a specific subscription, showing how tracked fields changed over time.
Retrieves a list of all unique categories from the user's subscriptions.
Retrieves a list of all unique categories from available services.
Retrieves all services in a non-paginated format, suitable for dropdown menus.
Retrieves a comprehensive spending summary for the specified period, including total spent, category breakdown, and top services. Defaults to current month if dates are not specified.
Retrieves projected spending for upcoming months based on active subscriptions.
Returns the current 2FA status including when it was enabled and number of remaining recovery codes.
Returns the profile information of the currently authenticated user.
Verifies a user's email address using the token from the verification email. This is a public endpoint that does not require authentication.
Returns the email verification status for the currently authenticated user, including grace period information and resend availability.
Retrieves a paginated list of all job executions. Requires ADMIN role.
Retrieves details of a specific job execution. Requires ADMIN role.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the user's account and all associated data. This action cannot be undone.

startDate.description: Subscription start date (ignored - auto-calculated from nextBillingDate and billingCycle)

expiresIn.description: Access token expiration time in seconds

emailVerified.description: Whether the user's email is verified

withinGracePeriod.description: Whether the user is within the grace period

emailVerificationEnabled.description: Whether email verification is enabled on the server

secret.description: The TOTP secret for manual entry in authenticator app

qrCodeDataUri.description: QR code as a data URI for authenticator app scanning

code.description: The 6-digit TOTP code from the authenticator app

TotpSetupVerifyRequest.description: Request to verify TOTP code during 2FA setup

recoveryCodes.description: List of recovery codes for backup authentication

items.description: List of recovery codes for backup authentication

TotpSetupCompleteResponse.description: Response containing recovery codes after 2FA setup completion

RecoveryCodeVerifyRequest.description: Request to verify a recovery code during login

code.description: The 6-digit TOTP code from the authenticator app

password.description: User's password (min 8 characters, must contain uppercase and number)

refreshToken.description: The refresh token obtained during login

RefreshTokenRequest.description: Request containing a refresh token for token refresh or logout operations

rememberMe.description: Extend token expiration for longer sessions

changedAt.description: Timestamp when the change was recorded

count.description: Number of subscriptions in this category

earliestSubscriptionDate.description: Earliest subscription start date for the user

totalSpent.description: Total amount spent in the period

remainingRecoveryCodes.description: Number of remaining unused recovery codes

verifiedAt.description: Timestamp when the email was verified

withinGracePeriod.description: Whether the user is within the grace period

gracePeriodEndsAt.description: Timestamp when the grace period ends

canResend.description: Whether a new verification email can be requested

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the record was created
